description: Shared contract: how industry labels are classified. Used by backend/tests/test_add_on_scoring.py (rank_add_ons) and frontend/src/lib/fitEngine.test.js (scoreIndustry). exact = identical after lower-casing and whitespace collapsing; similar = Indel ratio >= 80; different = anything else.
